title: [Bug]: lack record to longterm memory under static control mode, when the reply condition is met with structured output
body: **AgentScope is an open-source project. To involve a broader community, we recommend asking your questions in English.** **Describe the bug** under static_control mode, the agent will return messages without recording to the longterm memory **To Reproduce** set the structured_output, and longterm memory mode is "static_control" **Expected behavior** Under static_control mode, expected to record to longterm memory when successfully generate structured_output **Environment (please complete the following information):** - AgentScope Version: [e.g. 1.0.0 via `print(agentscope.__version__)`] - Python Version: [e.g. 3.10] - OS: [e.g. macos, windows] **Additional context** Add any other context about the problem here.

linked_prs.title: add record_to_memory before generate return reply_message
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/agentscope/agent/_react_agent.py b/src/agentscope/agent/_react_agent.py
index 3b0dc0607d..906d3dce50 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/agent/_react_agent.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/agent/_react_agent.py
@@ -305,6 +305,7 @@ async def reply(  # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
         # -------------- The reasoning-acting loop --------------
         # Cache the structured output generated in the finish function call
         structured_output = None
+        reply_msg = None
         for _ in range(self.max_iters):
             # -------------- The reasoning process --------------
             msg_reasoning = await self._reasoning(tool_choice)
@@ -339,12 +340,13 @@ async def reply(  # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
                     if msg_reasoning.has_content_blocks("text"):
                         # Re-use the existing text response if any to avoid
                         # duplicate text generation
-                        return Msg(
+                        reply_msg = Msg(
                             self.name,
                             msg_reasoning.get_content_blocks("text"),
                             "assistant",
                             metadata=structured_output,
                         )
+                        break
 
                     # Generate a textual response in the next iteration
                     msg_hint = Msg(
@@ -383,11 +385,15 @@ async def reply(  # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
                 # Exit the loop when no structured output is required (or
                 # already satisfied) and only text response is generated
                 msg_reasoning.metadata = structured_output
-                return msg_reasoning
+                reply_msg = msg_reasoning
+                break
 
         # When the maximum iterations are reached
-        reply_msg = await self._summarizing()
-        reply_msg.metadata = structured_output
+        # and no reply message is generated
+        if reply_msg is None:
+            reply_msg = await self._summarizing()
+            reply_msg.metadata = structured_output
+            await self.memory.add(reply_msg)
 
         # Post-process the memory, long-term memory
         if self._static_control:
@@ -399,7 +405,6 @@ async def reply(  # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
                 ],
             )
 
-        await self.memory.add(reply_msg)
         return reply_msg
 
     # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
